message: 恋人のその先に

name: Synn
message: 「Good work today, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「Good work to you too. Even though the Holy Night Festival took so long to prepare for, the cleanup was finished in a single day」
Walking along our usual route from school, we thank each other for our hard work.
The day after the Holy Night Festival, we took everything down with the help of all the participants.
By the time the two of us finished our final inspection as president and vice president, the sun had completely set.
Not a single trace of the Holy Night Festival remains anywhere. Yet, precisely because its physical presence is gone, the memories will never be tarnished.

name: Synn
message: 「Calling it a sense of desolation... might be an exaggeration, but now that it's over, it feels bright and refreshing, yet a little lonely」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, I understand that feeling well...」

name: Misa
message: 「However, it isn't over in the slightest, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「I know. Our next big job is the third-years' graduation ceremony, right」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hold on, you're getting way ahead of yourself! I meant that Christmas is still going on!」

name: Misa
message: 「Everyone only gets excited about Christmas Eve on the 24th, but today is actually the Nativity... the main event of Christmas」

name: Synn
message: 「Various clubs are holding after-parties, and some people are attending church mass too」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right. And I've properly made plans of my own, you know」

name: Misa
message: 「Usually it's only breakfast, but... tonight on Christmas, I'll be celebrating together with Father and Mother」

name: Misa
message: 「After all, you...」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee, that's why I decided a long time ago that this is how I would spend Christmas」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, that's great」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, thank you...」
The fork in the road on our way home, splitting toward Misa's house and my apartment.
Normally, Misa's pace slows down as we approach this spot, yet tonight she's actually walking faster.

name: Synn
message: 「Go have fun, Misa. And tell me all about it tomorrow」

name: Misa
message: 「D-Don't talk as if it has nothing to do with you...!」

name: Synn
message: 「It doesn't have nothing to do with me? You and I are lovers, aren't we」

name: Misa
message: 「Exactly! That's why I'm having you come with me to the Christeles family dinner party!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaaat!?」

name: Misa
message: 「What's your problem!? Why are you so surprised? How rude!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I never heard anything about you inviting me over……」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I just told you right now, didn't I?」

name: Synn
message: 「Tell me in advance! I haven't even been to the barber, and I don't have a gift ready either!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, that's not even the biggest issue! I haven't thought about what to say to greet them at all. What am I supposed to do!?」

name: Misa
message: 「You don't need any of that.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not gonna fly. I mean, I'm meeting your parents for the very first time, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, here's a quiz question for you.」

name: Misa
message: 「A boy and a girl who used to be strangers became lovers. What happens to their relationship from here on out?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's――」

name: Synn
message: 「We become family.」

name: Misa
message: 「Spot on.」

name: Misa
message: 「S-So, please…… w-with me……」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm spending Christmas with my family. At Misa's house.」

name: Misa
message: 「Phew, thank goodness~」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Oh? Isn't that snow…… When did it start?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's been snowing for a while now?」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph! I knew that, I was just saying it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. You were so nervous you didn't even notice it started snowing, and you still invited me.」

name: Misa
message: 「T-That's not it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「I told you that's not it!!」

name: Misa
message: 「You're always, always treating me like--」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, Misa, let's go」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What do you think you're doing, holding my hand?」

name: Misa
message: 「We're having the Christmas party at my house, not yours, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine. Your place is roughly over in that direction, right, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「You don't even know where it is, and you're trying to escort me!?」

name: Misa
message: 「I suppose I have no choice--I'll show you the way」

name: Synn
message: 「Could you tell me about your parents on the way there?」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's see. Father and Mother are sure to hit it off with your parents」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't know why I feel that way, I just do」

name: Synn
message: 「That's probably because we're--」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes. Because you and I are--」
--two of a kind--
